reason: Use Tier 2: replace uniform preference pooling with learned recency-weighted pooling inside the existing network. Restoring attention together with gated preference fusion improved macro HR@10 from 0.4962 to 0.5237, but Electronics remains below its 0.420 SASRec baseline at 0.365. Uniform pooling treats distant and recent purchases equally; learning the preference timescale tests a specific representation limitation while retaining the successful backbone. The supplied history does not detail the five plateau attempts, so their individual failure causes cannot be established.

plan.model_design: Make one atomic Tier 2 change in ConvRec.forward: replace the uniform prefix mean with a normalized, causal exponential moving average of raw item embeddings. Add one jointly trained scalar log_decay per category model, initialize softplus(log_decay) to log(2)/20, and construct weights W[t,s] = exp(-softplus(log_decay)*(t-s)) for s<=t, with zero weights elsewhere. Compute pooled = (W @ raw) / (W @ mask).clamp_min(1e-8), then mask padded outputs; this lets each category learn how quickly persistent preferences should adapt without introducing another predictor. Preserve ConvRec.__init__, forward(seq), training_loss(seq,pos,neg), predict(seq,candidates), existing attribute names, convolution and attention blocks, history_projection, history_norm, history_gate, output bias, and the 32-negative classification objective.
plan.training_evaluation: Keep sampling, optimizer, schedule, seeds, supplied splits, training limits, and checkpoint selection unchanged so the experiment isolates the pooling modification. Ensure write_predict_script reconstructs the revised ConvRec and strictly loads its state, including log_decay, while retaining predict(user_id,history,candidates,*,dataset_name=None), shared pack_history processing, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], and trial-local artifacts. Verify causal invariance, finite empty-history outputs, and checkpoint-reload prediction parity with small checks that preserve training RNG state. Train all four categories from scratch on one GPU, deploy exactly one selected checkpoint per category, and compare actual pinned-host macro and category HR@10 against 0.5237; print the selected checkpoints' local macro validation score without accessing hidden test files or fabricating submission data.
